description: Same format in both conditions. Original answer bytes must be retained before parsing. Format validity is not semantic credit.

required_fields.answers: One or more entries for each named question, in its original order; use separate entries for propositions requiring different verdicts

answer_fields.question_id: Name from the assigned questions object
answer_fields.verdict: supported, contradicted, or insufficient_evidence for the proposition explicitly stated in this entry
answer_fields.proposition: Precisely identify what this verdict assesses; mixed questions may have multiple entries
answer_fields.objects_and_input: Exact construction IDs, tables/maps or machine/input/step as relevant
answer_fields.conclusion: Values and conclusion, including any explicitly identified deduction
answer_fields.evidence_status: source proof, recorded execution, independent computation, deduction, or absent evidence, as applicable
answer_fields.citations: List of {reference, locator, supports}; locator is a declaration, JSON pointer, or original line number
answer_fields.explanation: Plain-language justification, including why cited hypotheses apply

scoring: Missing fields stay missing. Parsing or valid JSON does not establish correctness; the eight-dimension rubric and blind applicability review decide semantic scores.
